item.title: FSU baseball opens 2026 season with win as fans hope for championship run
item.description: The Seminoles defeated James Madison in Friday's season opener at Dick Howser Stadium. And with the Savannah Bananas coming to town this month, Tallahassee is full of baseball fever.

item.title: Valdosta's first Mardi Gras celebration will raise funds for children in foster care
item.description: Valdosta's inaugural Mardi Gras celebration by Krewe de Fondatrice will support CASA volunteers who advocate for children in foster care. Saturday's events include a vendor market and Community Day.

item.title: Hundreds celebrate at Night to Shine Tallahassee, bringing joy to people with special needs
item.description: The prom event in Tallahassee brought joy to hundreds of people with special needs. The Tim Tebow Foundation event featured a red carpet treatment, dancing, and volunteer buddies.
